title: Never Turn Your Wheel While Parked (Part 1)
hook: Stop turning your wheels while parked.

script.narration: Stop turning your wheels while parked.
script.visual_search: close up of car tires turning on asphalt

script.narration: Dry steering grinds your steering components against heavy friction without tire roll, wearing down your linkage fast.

description: Stop dry steering your car and save your suspension. Learn why turning your wheels while completely stopped causes unnecessary wear on your vehicle's steering system. Follow so you don't miss Part 2!
why_it_will_work: Leverages viewer interest in practical vehicle mechanics and beginner driving lessons, following the proven success of our short steering technique videos.
